zeroconf_confirm.title: Car 2 Home discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: The app {model} on {host} wants to pair with Home Assistant. Continue?

pair.title: Pair with Car 2 Home
pair.description:
## Pairing code

# {code}

Enter this code in the mobile app to finish pairing.

1. Open the **Car 2 Home** app on your phone.
2. Go to **Settings → Home Assistant**.
3. Select the **Integration** tab.
4. Enter the URL of this Home Assistant instance (e.g. `{ha_url}`).
5. Tap **Pair**, type the code above, and confirm.
6. Come back here and click **Submit** to finish.

The code expires at **{expires_at}** (in {ttl_minutes} minutes).

pair_link.title: Add another phone
pair_link.description:
Use this to add **another phone** to your existing garage. If that phone is signed in to the same account, it joins the same garage and feeds the same vehicles. The phone already connected keeps working.

## Pairing code

# {code}

Enter this code in the mobile app to finish pairing.

1. Open the **Car 2 Home** app on the phone you are adding.
2. Go to **Settings → Home Assistant**.
3. Select the **Integration** tab.
4. Enter the URL of this Home Assistant instance (e.g. `{ha_url}`).
5. Tap **Pair**, type the code above, and confirm.
6. Come back here and click **Submit** to finish.

The code expires at **{expires_at}** (in {ttl_minutes} minutes).
